nodes.label: Exam Specific Math Sets
nodes.rationale: Math questions stay specific to each exam instead of being shared.

nodes.label: Passage Sets
nodes.rationale: Each passage and its related questions live together; formatters keep title, byline, spacing, and line numbering outside the passage text.

nodes.label: Matching Server Assessment Record
nodes.rationale: A matching server assessment record is required for the exam to appear on teacher and student dashboards.

nodes.label: Practice Question Validation
nodes.rationale: Question IDs must remain unique across the practice system; Content Studio validates required fields and duplicate IDs before appending a PracticeQuestion.

nodes.label: Exam Player Content Loading
nodes.rationale: The player loads registered local content by assessmentId and falls back to basic server assessment data when a local test is unregistered.

nodes.label: Exam Section Ordering
nodes.rationale: passageSections allows Reading Comprehension to shuffle while Revising/Editing Part A retains saved order; Part B uses standaloneSection.

nodes.label: Difficulty Partitioned Topic Banks
nodes.rationale: Each topic separates easy, medium, hard, and elite questions into files so banks grow without oversized files; topic index.ts combines all four levels for the quiz interface.
